A '''hyperlane''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] ran into the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] via the [[Lo'Uran system/Legends|Lo'Uran system]] and then passed through the [[Ninn system/Legends|Ninn system]] before ending at the [[Lythos system/Legends|Lythos system]]. The Lythos [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was also on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Authority Guardian Corridor]], meaning the system acted as a junction between the three [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hyperlane first appeared in the sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[2009]]. The lane was depicted in a map of the Corporate Sector but not named or mentioned in any text. The lane continued off the edge of the map but where it continues to is not shown anywhere else in the book.
